notes: DiscoFlate v3.84.6 — 🖥 The Chat tab loads itself now. Landing on it at page load left the log and the webcam blank until you clicked to another tab and back: showTab() only toggles the CSS, and the work a tab needs on becoming visible — the channel list, the first poll, the video section — was only ever wired to the tab-button click. And the camera preview killed its own timer on the first failed frame, so opening the tab before the camera was up, or one blip while it ran, ended the preview permanently. It now slows down instead of dying and picks itself back up within a few seconds.
